statements.status_notes: logback is the non-default, optional logging backend for the operator; the image uses log4j2 by default. The fix requires logback 1.5.25+, which requires slf4j 2.x while Flink 1.20 bundles slf4j 1.7.x and the log4j-slf4j (1.7) binding. Adopting the fix means migrating the entire logging stack (slf4j 2.x plus a log4j-slf4j2 binding swap), which would change the default log4j2 path; assessment of that migration is pending. Severity is LOW (CVSS 1.8) and exploitation requires local high-privilege access.

Fixed in logback-core 1.5.25. The 1.5.x line requires Java 11+; the 1.3.x line is the last Java-8-compatible series and is no longer receiving backports. Stargate is currently pinned to Java 8 by its maven-enforcer rule. Will bump to 1.5.x when stargate supports Java 11+. Severity is LOW (CVSS 1.8); exploit requires local high-privilege access.
